_comment: People Manager settings. INSTALL_APP.sh copies this to config.json (which is never committed). Everything here is also editable in the app under Settings. Paths are relative to this file. Only server.port and server.allowNetwork need a restart (./PEOPLE.sh --restart); everything else applies at once.

server._comment: allowNetwork false = only this computer can open the app (127.0.0.1). true = other devices on your network can too, at http://<this computer>:<port>. Both need a restart.

security._comment: loginEnabled true = ask for a login name and password. The credentials live in passwordFile (bcrypt hash, owner-only). No file = you are asked to create a login. Forgot the password? Delete the file and reload — your people are not touched.

dataSource._comment: type is json, sqlite or mysql. A new SQLite or MySQL source needs its tables built once: Settings → Data source → Build database, or ./SETUP_SQLITE_DB.sh / ./SETUP_MYSQL_DB.sh.

photos._comment: Photos are stored as files in dir/<person id>/. They are never part of an export or backup — copy this folder yourself.

appearance._comment: theme is light, dark, system (follows your computer) or the id of one of your customThemes (made in Settings → Appearance).
